title: Russian Geran-3 Drones Injure 4 in Kharkiv as Zaporizhzhia Industrial Facility Set Ablaze
detail: Russian forces struck Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district with Geran-3 UAVs on the evening of August 25, injuring four people (three suffered acute stress reactions), damaging six residential houses and five vehicles, according to Kharkiv Oblast Governor Oleh Syniehubov. Separately that evening, Russian strikes hit an industrial facility in Zaporizhzhia, setting a building and vehicles on fire; no casualties were reported there. It followed an earlier round of Russian drone attacks on Zaporizhzhia that afternoon that injured seven people and set roughly 10 vehicles ablaze. Ukraine's General Staff reported the wider nationwide barrage that day included 1 Iskander-M ballistic missile, 1 Kh-31P guided missile, and 150 strike UAVs across Sumy, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kherson, Kyiv, Odesa, Chernihiv, Mykolaiv, and Poltava oblasts.

title: Ukrainian Drones Destroy Russian Logistics Depot in Occupied Melitopol After State TV Exposed Generator Delivery
detail: Ukraine's 422nd Separate Unmanned Systems Regiment 'Luftwaffe' (17th Army Corps) struck a Russian logistics hub set up by occupation forces inside a former Epicentr hardware store in occupied Melitopol, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, on August 25, destroying a large consignment of generators and military equipment. Russian state television had inadvertently exposed the delivery days earlier by broadcasting footage of the newly arrived generators, providing Ukrainian operators with targeting intelligence.
